title: Rusty Key
body:
-"?? ?? ??? ?"-

The Adurite Key is a special quest item obtained by completing the Pedestal Puzzle, which involves placing three different Refined tools (the Refined Axe, the Refined Chisel, and the Refined Pickaxe) onto their respective pedestals. This key is part of a larger puzzle required to make the Emberbane axe.

Appearance

The Adurite Key is a skeleton key with a heptagonally shaped ring, a long shaft and two equal-size teeth. It appears to be rusty and corroded. This item is roughly 2.5 studs in length.

Obtaining

Note: It is advised to do this quest on a solo/private server. When the Key spawns, it doesn't have an owner, which can result in it being stolen.
  • Go to Mike's Mines from the Finlay Island entrance. Keep right until you see a large lake with wood planks suspended above it near the cave roof. Locate the rusty truss (ladder) and parkour across the planks until you reach the designated location. After climbing the truss you should see a little room in the cave ceiling with the red button at the end, surrounded by floating red particles. Watch this video to see how to complete the parkour without the usage of a gravity coil. If the button is nowhere to be seen, this means that a person in your server already toggled the quest, you can then skip that part and go to the next quest
  • Buy the required refined tools found at The Oak Depot, these being: Refined Axe [$21,000], Refined Chisel [$5,000], Refined Pickaxe [$21,000]. The total price of these items is $47,000.
  • Bring the Refined Axe onto the pedestal located infront of Alan's AutoLogistics. If done correctly, the pedestal will emit green particles.
  • Bring the Refined Chisel onto the pedestal located at the bottom of the canyon, underneath the right bridge.
  • Bring the Refined Pickaxe onto the pedestal located just before the Lighthouse, in the middle of the lost forest.
  • If successful, the items on the pedestals will disappear, the green lines will appear, and then you will hear 3 "poof" sounds followed by a loud bang. Immediately drive to the highest point where Corpse Flowers are found in the Acid Wastes to claim your Adurite Key, which awaits atop the pedestal.

Map Guide

Trivia

  • This is the first quest item to be added into Oaklands.
  • The developers had to alter the puzzle due to being too difficult to solve when it was initially implemented.
  • This item has been renamed to "Adurite Key".
  • Obtaining this item is similar to Uncertain Pickaxe's obtainment.
